entries.message: This update includes consolidate watchlist sync simplification, retire Emby/Jellyfin clients, keep sidebar footer visible and style scrollbars, and tighten and tidy the left sidebar layout.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Removed Emby and Jellyfin watchlist clients (library-specific playlists/favorites cannot hold unwatched titles and are operationally unsound)
Simplified Personal Rating and Watchlist sync to unified single toggle in Settings
Updated all docs to reflect Plex-only watchlist support with safe first-run union, durable retry queues, and provider-owned state tracking
Refactored watchlist sync settings UI into single cohesive panel with status, queue preview, manual sync, and provider recovery actions
Updated CLAUDE.md with managed Windows workspace Git permission requirements
Updated test suite for watchlist provider adapters and backup/restore scenarios
Aligned Settings, onboarding, and help-content modules with new unified sync flow
Pin the sidebar footer to the bottom of the viewport so expanding navigation does not push controls below the fold
Style the sidebar scrollbar with a slim profile matching the dark/light theme
Flush the gap between the search box and the first nav item to a small 10px spacing
Keep the sidebar footer (Sync - Idle, version, Appearance) below the nav so its scrollbar no longer overlaps it
Constrain the sidebar scroll to vertical only so indented rows no longer surface a horizontal scrollbar
messageFragments: Docs - Consolidate watchlist sync simplification, retire Emby/Jellyfin clients
Fix - Keep sidebar footer visible and style scrollbars
Fix - Tighten and tidy the left sidebar layout
